absent: Admin command transport, completion, timeout and status propagation for device parts set.
Implementations of the configuration operation handlers for status, queues, features, affinity and shared memory.
Common configuration register layout and feature negotiation sequencing beyond driver feature readout.
Packed ring buffer addition, completion retrieval, detach, poll, callback enable, resize and reset paths.
Split ring completion retrieval, indirect teardown, in-order batch reaping and queue reset behavior.
Notification mechanism, interrupt handling and full memory ordering rules for producer and consumer.
Ring allocation, DMA setup, ownership transfer and error recovery after the broken flag is set.

findings.text: Resolves the host physical function device from a virtual function PCI device and fails when absent, derives the virtual function index and propagates a negative result, then composes an administration command selecting device parts set within the SR-IOV group addressing the member one past that index with the caller scatter table attached and dispatches it through the modern admin execution path.

Two configuration operation tables share handlers for generation, status access, reset, queue discovery and teardown, callback synchronization, extended feature handling, bus naming, affinity, shared memory region and queue reset sequencing, differing only in device configuration byte access where the nodevice variant disables read and write while the full variant enables them.

Clears the caller feature accumulator then walks the full feature space in thirty two bit steps, selecting each word through the common configuration selector and merging the observed value into the appropriate half of the sixty four bit accumulator entries to reconstruct the complete driver visible set.

Two build variants define corruption handling for a queue: the debug variant reports through the device error path and then traps unconditionally, while the production variant reports similarly but marks the queue permanently broken so later operations can fail gracefully rather than trapping.

Debug builds enforce exclusive queue use with callers holding an external lock: entry records the call site when idle and panics on reentry, exit asserts prior entry and clears the marker; release builds remove both checks entirely, leaving mutual exclusion solely to the caller.

Debug builds track delay between buffer addition and kick or inspection by stamping a monotonic time on add with a warning if the prior stamp aged beyond about a tenth of a second, rechecking age on kick preparation, and providing invalidation after kick; release builds define all three operations as no-ops.

Queue layout selects among four modes covering split versus packed ring formats each with or without strict in-order completion, with split in-order using a monotonically advancing head and packed in-order leaving free list tracking unused.

Per descriptor software state for split rings pairs a completion token with an indirect table pointer and accumulated inbound length, while packed state adds list length and tail position plus skipped buffer inbound length; a companion extra record retains DMA address, length, flags and successor index for mapping lifetime and chain linkage.

Split queue storage combines the shared ring memory with shadow copies of available flags and index, per descriptor state and extra arrays, DMA address and byte size of the queue allocation, plus alignment and shrink permission retained for rebuilding.

Packed queue storage holds ring size with descriptor and driver and device event areas, a driver wrap counter with associated avail and used flags and next available index, shadowed event flags, per descriptor state and extra arrays, and separate DMA addresses and byte sizes for the descriptor ring and event areas.

Backend dispatch vector abstracts queue operations for adding buffers, retrieving completions, preparing kicks, disabling and enabling callbacks including delayed and polled forms, detaching unused buffers, testing for more used entries, resizing and resetting.

Central queue object extends the generic queue with DMA and barrier capability flags, broken and indirect and event capability indicators, layout selector, free or next head index, in-order batch tail record, count of additions since last synchronization, last observed used position with packed wrap encoding, detach cursor, event hint, split or packed union, notify callback, ownership and mapping info, and debug only reentry and timing fields.
The available event notification index for split rings is aliased to the word immediately following the used ring entries, sized by the queue length.

Split ring observers fetch used index, used entry identifier and length, and available event value with a single atomic read each followed by device endian to host conversion, avoiding torn or reordered host updates.
Packed ring observers fetch descriptor flags, identifier and length with a single atomic read each followed by little endian to host conversion.

Indirect tables are chosen only when the host advertises support, the request spans multiple scatter elements, and free space remains; a direct mapping needs unmapping only when DMA services are in use and the recorded address is valid.

Single entry mapping honors premapped inputs by reusing their DMA address and length, otherwise records scatter length and either sanitizes and uses the physical address when DMA services are bypassed or maps the page range through queue DMA services with failure reported as out of memory; coherent single buffer mapping similarly chooses physical address or DMA service based on capability.

Split unmapping skips DMA release for untracked or non-DMA direct entries and for indirect entries when DMA services are bypassed, otherwise releases the recorded range with direction derived from the write flag, and returns the successor link for chain unwinding.

Indirect allocation for split rings excludes high memory to keep descriptor addresses directly translatable, co-allocates descriptor and extra arrays in one block with extras placed after descriptors, fails cleanly on exhaustion, and pre-chains extra successors sequentially.

Descriptor installation converts address, length, flags and successor into device byte order for the ring entry while retaining host order address, length and flags plus premapping status in the companion extra slot, then yields the successor index.

Split addition validates the completion token, rejects broken queues, selects indirect versus inline placement, enforces free space accounting with conditional notification on shortage, maps outgoing then incoming elements chaining all but the last, accumulates inbound length, maps and links the indirect table when used, advances free accounting via wraparound head for in-order or free list successor otherwise, stores token and indirect or context state, publishes the head into the available ring under a write barrier with shadow index and addition count updates, forces a kick near sixteen bit counter saturation, and on mapping failure unwinds only completed mappings and frees any indirect block.
Write ordering selects a lightweight virtualization barrier when weak barriers are permitted and a DMA barrier otherwise.

Split kick preparation enforces exclusive use and full ordering, snapshots the newly added range and clears the pending count with timing check and invalidation, then requests notification either by comparing the host event index against the new and old positions when event indexing is negotiated or by testing the used flags no-notify bit otherwise.
Event suppression uses wrap safe unsigned sixteen bit arithmetic to decide whether the new producer index advanced past the host requested event threshold relative to the previous position.

Addition failure modes are distinguished: broken queue surfaces as input output error, insufficient descriptors as no space with prior outgoing content still notified, and DMA or indirect table mapping failure as out of memory after partial unwind; success paths must not leak the indirect block.
